Arina Demina wrote a review Jun 2026
1 contribution1 helpful vote

An unforgettable trip to Arizona

We took an amazing bus tour from Las Vegas to Horseshoe Bend and Lower Antelope Canyon, and it was absolutely worth every dollar!

The tour cost $189, and although the drive was about 4 hours each way, the journey was very comfortable. We were picked up early in the morning (around 4:50–5:30 AM) from a convenient location in Las Vegas, and along the way we even made a stop in Utah to enjoy the beautiful mountain views.

One thing that really impressed us was how well everything was organized. Snacks and drinks were included throughout the day: granola bars, unlimited cold water, a delicious ham sandwich, a Danish pastry, chips, a mandarin orange, and juice. We even had a lovely little picnic overlooking the canyon.

Our first stop was Horseshoe Bend, which was absolutely breathtaking. After lunch, we headed to Lower Antelope Canyon, one of the most famous and photogenic places in the Southwest. Our guide there was fantastic—he shared local legends, played traditional instruments, and took countless photos for everyone in the group. He truly made the experience special.

We arrived back in Las Vegas around 8 PM, tired but incredibly happy. The scenery, the organization, our guide Josh and our driver James, and the overall experience exceeded our expectations.

Highly recommended!
Value for money

Fantastic Experience!

Had a fantastic experience on the Lower Antelope Canyon tour. The canyon itself is absolutely stunning, with incredible rock formations, colors, and natural patterns that are even more impressive in person.

Theresa, our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and did a great job explaining the history of Utah, Arizona and geology of the canyon while also keeping good time during our breaks and visits.

Safe, well-paced trip with outstanding guides

Our trip was excellently organized and perfectly paced from start to finish. Guide Sarah and driver Jack provided a safe, comfortable experience throughout. Cold water and snacks were available the entire time, and we appreciated the rest stop after the two-hour ride from Vegas, along with the vault toilets at the tourist sites.

Sarah was attentive and regularly checked that we had everything we needed. She managed time expertly, gave clear instructions, and set accurate reminders so we always had enough time to walk, take photos, and rest. Her travel tips also helped us make the most of each location. The roughly 600-mile journey was a success thanks to Jack’s safe and steady driving.

The Lower Antelope Canyon portion felt a bit rushed, but given the limited capacity and the need to prioritize safety around potential flash floods, this arrangement made complete sense. The canyon guide kept the tour lively and showed us a few spots for photos, which added a lot to the experience. Safety clearly came first on this tour, and that gave us real peace of mind.

The bus was comfortable with air conditioning, which was especially appreciated given the heat. Peter made sure everyone had cold water, along with tasty snacks throughout the trip. You could really feel how much they cared about the passengers’ comfort.

The canyons themselves were absolutely breathtaking incredible views, a well-planned route, and plenty of time for photos. We highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for such an unforgettable experience!

Big thanks from Kazakhstan 🇰🇿🩵

Two Bucket-List Destinations in One Amazing Day

What a well-thought-out tour from Las Vegas! This trip included two absolute must-sees: Horseshoe Bend and Lower Antelope Canyon, and it was organized flawlessly from start to finish.

It was a long day, but everything was efficient, well-timed, and straight to the point. The lunch stop was a pleasant surprise—much better than expected and a nice break during the journey.

A special thank you to Josh, our tour guide, who was thoughtful, informative, and attentive throughout the day. He made sure everyone felt comfortable and well taken care of. Jack was also an excellent driver, navigating the long route safely and smoothly. He went above and beyond by making sure guests had cold bottled water before and after each hike, which was especially appreciated in the desert heat.

If you’re looking to see Horseshoe Bend and Lower Antelope Canyon in one day from Las Vegas, I highly recommend this tour. Great organization, great staff, and unforgettable scenery!
